notes.title: Release date set for 2026
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603620/5c8a0b07f889ddc6faee200fc76095841667b797.png"]

As foreshadowed in the previous announcement, the release date for Lobstar: Arcade Version has indeed been moved and set to next year's National Lobster Day.

The goal of this project is to make something I'm personally satisfied with, and my development pace behind the scenes has shifted drastically over the last few months. Thus, a couple more months beyond September 2025 are needed to hit my personal minimum bar for release. 
I would like this game to come out on September 25 specifically for thematic and memetic reasons, so that means a one year delay.



Rest assured, it'll still be released for free.



Thanks for reading,

Lobstar Dev

notes.title: Note about Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello, and thanks to all reading for your interest in this strange lobster game.

Lobstar: Arcade Version is set to release on National Lobster Day as observed in the US--September 25th--because I can.

Though the date is set, the year may change. It'll release on September 25th of some year, either this one or a future one.

If the year is moved, I'll send out an announcement.



Thanks for your understanding,

Lobstar Dev
